_note: Inputs only. Every figure shown on the site is computed from this file by lib/economics.ts, so a number on the page can never drift from the number in the model. `given` is the operator's specification. `assumed` has not been validated against a real fleet yet and is labelled as such wherever it is rendered. `monthlyAccountCreditUsd` is a published Tesla figure that is deliberately NOT applied to any calculation — it is carried here only so the page can name it in a footnote from a single source rather than typing it into prose.

basis.fxKrwPerUsd: Round figure for presentation. Re-quote before any published cost claim.
basis.avgKmPerMonth: Korean passenger-car average, ~14,000 km/year. Tesla owners in Korea likely drive more; this is the conservative side for reward cost and the aggressive side for data volume.
basis.redemptionMix: Unvalidated. The single most important number in the model — see tests/economics.test.ts, which fails the build if the three shares do not sum to 1.
basis.partnerCommissionRate: Placeholder pending a signed partner. No commission has been contracted.
